english: Actions are judged by intentions.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
Religion is sincere advice.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
english: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
He who does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
Purity is half of faith.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
english: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.
Supplication is the essence of worship.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult.
Whoever humbles himself for Allah, Allah will raise him.
Spread peace among yourselves.
Fear Allah wherever you are.
Be moderate and seek what is right.
A kind word is charity.
Do not become angry.
Love for people what you love for yourself.
Whoever remains silent is saved.
The believer is the mirror of his brother.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

arabic: أَحْسِنُوا إِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ وَأَحْسِنُوا إِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ
english: When you kill, kill well; when you slaughter, slaughter well.
Modesty is a branch of faith.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
The one consulted is entrusted.

arabic: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ
english: No one who has an atom’s weight of arrogance in his heart will enter Paradise.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
english: Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.

arabic: المُؤْمِنُ القَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ المُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
english: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer.
Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.

arabic: مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرِ اللَّهَ
english: Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah.
The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful.

arabic: اتْرُكْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
english: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُونَ كَرَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ، إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوٌ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى
english: The believers are like one body; if one part suffers, the whole body feels pain.
